Within-between (Mundlak) decomposition of a numeric variable

Source: R/utils.R
pollin_within_between.Rd

Splits a numeric vector into a between-group part (the group mean, broadcast back to each row) and a within-group part (the deviation from that mean). Used to separate the within-unit component of an exposure – which is robust to any unit-level confounder, observed or not – from the between-unit component.

Usage

pollin_within_between(x, group)

Arguments

x

Numeric vector.

group

Grouping factor of the same length as x.

Value

A list with elements within and between, each the length of x.

Examples

wb <- pollin_within_between(c(1, 3, 10, 12), c("a", "a", "b", "b"))
wb$between
#> [1]  2  2 11 11
wb$within
#> [1] -1  1 -1  1
